deviation: The 1x cap matches the standard. But the draft's uncapped carve-outs don't follow the playbook. It adds gross negligence and wilful misconduct, which the playbook doesn't allow, and it omits the IP infringement indemnity and confidentiality breach carve-outs. It also adds a blanket exclusion of indirect and consequential loss and lost profits, with no carve-outs. That could block Arcadia from recovering most of its loss from a supplier confidentiality or IP breach.
suggested_text:
10.1 Cap. Subject to Section 10.2, each Party's total aggregate liability arising under this Agreement shall not exceed 1 times the annual fees paid or payable.

10.2 Exceptions. Nothing in this Agreement limits or excludes either Party's liability for (a) fraud; (b) indemnification for third-party intellectual property infringement claims; (c) breach of confidentiality obligations; or (d) any liability that cannot be limited or excluded under applicable law.

(Delete draft Section 10.2, the exclusion of indirect loss. If the supplier insists on it, accept it only if it is mutual and does not apply to the liabilities listed in 10.2(a)–(d) above.)
